name: Vegetable Dalia Khichdi
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ¼ cup split moong dal, rinsed
1 tsp ginger and 1 green chilli, minced
1 extra cup non-starchy vegetables (spinach, cabbage or green beans), chopped
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and add ginger and chilli.
Add the extra chopped vegetables together with the other vegetables.
Add the dalia, moong dal, vegetables, turmeric and salt and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the water and pressure-cook for 3–4 whistles, or simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes and mash lightly.
note: Broken wheat has more fibre than white rice and keeps you full for longer.
